Does not certify arbitrary frameworks.

Headless native macOS style is not a qualified configuration
Quick selectOption requires supported non-editable closed-popup ComboBox

rules: A driver action still requires a supported control interface
Application language alone does not qualify a toolkit
A source workflow is not a recorded platform pass
C++ authoring is a bounded bridge; Python/C#/Rust authoring SDKs are not included
Unknown visibility cannot satisfy visible or hidden assertions
Readonly preflight can be retried; uncertain mutations cannot be replayed
No OS sidecar keyboard input, screenshots, native video or hybrid DOM switching
